in_service_closure_census.method: walk every {path, sha256} pair transitively from the two in-service lineage roots that the live launch specs name, resolve each, and scan every string for the retiring bank directory, the retiring clip SHA and the retiring plant
the_shapes_that_hide: the prototype carries it a third time under /scopes/full/0/npz_sha256, a leaf name that neither of the other two shapes uses
the dynamic-ready artifact carries it five times under four different field paths, one of which only names the bank directory and never the SHA
two of the five tape target receipts are in the closure and three are not, so a scan of the tape directory alone over- or under-counts depending on which end you start from

the_pointer_chain_that_would_have_been_m.name: the ActionBall launchers pin the pre-converted USD of the RETIRED plant, by SHA, in code
the_pointer_chain_that_would_have_been_m.where: hope_training/whole_body_tracking/scripts/launch_n1_reward_screen_diagnostic.py:118 A3_RUNTIME_USD_BUNDLE_SHA256, enforced at :1845 _validate_runtime_asset_paths and required at :1905 _validate_runtime_asset_environment; launch_action_ball_a211_four_arm_diagnostic.py and launch_action_ball_c211_diagnostic.py both execute this same base module
the_pointer_chain_that_would_have_been_m.live_check: all six files under /workspace/franco/runtime_assets/a3_preconverted_usd_1b3fecd7 hash to exactly those values, so the pin is live and satisfied
the_pointer_chain_that_would_have_been_m.which_robot_it_actually_is: that bundle's config.yaml records asset_path = .../whole_body_tracking/assets/agibot_a3/urdf/model.urdf and 'Generated by UrdfConverter on 2026-07-17 at 19:19:04' - it is the RETIRED 0409 plant
the_pointer_chain_that_would_have_been_m.why_it_wins: robots/agibot_a3.py:182 returns UsdFileCfg(usd_path=$HOPE_AGIBOT_A3_USD_PATH) when the variable is set and never reaches the URDF branch, so the AGIBOT_A3_ASSET_ROOT constant that 82ee3ae8 moved to 0807 is dead code in this lane
the_pointer_chain_that_would_have_been_m.and_it_is_mandatory: removing the variable does not fall back to the URDF - the launcher refuses at plan time. Observed live in this round: 'PLAN_FAILED stage=materialize rc=2 / REFUSED: HOPE_AGIBOT_A3_USD_PATH must be a normalized absolute path'
the_pointer_chain_that_would_have_been_m.live_argv_evidence: the two four-cell runs in flight on this pod at the time of the census (/workspace/franco/remint_20260808 and /workspace/franco/bankswap_20260808, the latter at this same HEAD 766ccf91) both carry HOPE_AGIBOT_A3_USD_PATH=/workspace/franco/runtime_assets/a3_preconverted_usd_1b3fecd7/model.usd in /proc/<pid>/environ
the_pointer_chain_that_would_have_been_m.consequence: no ActionBall A211/C211 cell has ever booted the 0807 plant, and none can until this pin is re-cut. Re-minting the lineage onto the new bank before that would produce artifacts describing a robot the launcher then refuses to load - i.e. it would have to be minted twice.
the_pointer_chain_that_would_have_been_m.what_the_pin_does_not_check: nothing in the gate compares the USD to AGIBOT_A3_URDF_PATH or to configs/a3p_p1_0807_model_set_v1.json. It is a byte-integrity pin on a cache, not an identity pin on a plant - fingerprint present, semantics unchecked.

blocker_1_missing_producer.meaning: the bank swap cannot be completed with existing tooling. Producing this receipt means writing a new materializer, which needs its own gate and mutation tests, and that is a change to propose rather than to slip in under a switch.

blocker_2_live_evidence_artifacts.why_they_are_in_the_way: both pin the retiring clip SHA, and the core materializer cross-checks them against ACTION_FACTS, so neither can survive the swap. The dynamic-ready one also pins the missing BANK_IMPORT_RECEIPT. The nominal-hold one is a live Isaac probe receipt, so re-producing it needs a Kit boot - and that boot would run on the retired plant until blocker 3 is cleared.
blocker_2_live_evidence_artifacts.rebuild_depth: the swap therefore starts one level deeper than the 18-artifact re-mint of 2026-08-07: bank import receipt -> per-clip audit -> mechanical audit -> dynamic-ready -> Isaac nominal hold -> core -> tape -> A211 lineage -> C211 lineage + bundle

why_this_round_minted_nothing.blocker_3_plant_pin: see the_pointer_chain_that_would_have_been_missed - minting before the USD pin is re-cut guarantees a second mint

not_a_blocker.mechanical_admission_of_the_new_clip: audit_measured_racket_mechanical_admission.py on assets/motions/chingmu73_measured_a3p0807_20260808/hope_Take_061_unit04_BH.npz with --urdf pointing at the 0807 model.urdf returns overall_verdict UNKNOWN, exit 1, reasons exactly the three class-1 vendor-data-gap reasons and no hard position or velocity violation - the same standing the v4 clip had, so --allow-mechanical-unknown-diagnostic still applies and this is not what stops the swap

question_identity.why: the lineage clip's bytes change (aab1953b -> c7eb9af0), and the clip is an input to the prepared core, the contact alignment and the base question. ACTION_FACTS additionally carries four motion-derived numbers - reference_t_hit_s 0.96, reference_t_cycle_s 1.12, reference_racket_site_speed_mps 1.8901338577270508, strike_phase 0.8571 - which are re-measured from the new bytes rather than copied.
question_identity.what_that_costs: base_question_sha256 is currently 81eed5139b98... across the last two tape build reports. After the swap it is a different question, so readings taken before and after are not comparable arm-to-arm; any cross-round claim has to be re-baselined, not carried over.
question_identity.not_yet_measurable: the exact new base_question_sha256 cannot be quoted until the core and tape are actually built, and nothing was built here

regression.meaning: this round changed no code, so the number is a baseline at 766ccf91 for the next round to diff against, not evidence that anything was fixed
